title: Python for Data Analysis
shortDescription: Learn Python data skills with notebooks, data cleaning, and exploratory analysis.
description: Learn Python data skills with notebooks, data cleaning, and exploratory analysis. This course is designed for Cameroonian university students, graduates, independent learners, tutors, and small training organisations.
